ranking_method: priority_score is a 0-100 judgment combining information gain, mission value, falsification cost, reversibility, risk, dependency burden, and reuse value; assumptions remain explicit in each task.

items.title: Implement the minimum durable kernel and machine-readable registries
items.acceptance: Zero-dependency CLI validates Governor/state invariants, selects work deterministically, records allowed transitions, supports recovery, and passes tests.
items.reversal_condition: Replace the storage layer only when measured scale or concurrency makes versioned files inadequate.

items.title: Build a current primary-source opportunity register
items.acceptance: Five or more candidates are ranked with current primary evidence, economics, uncertainty, risks, falsification and reopening criteria.
items.reversal_condition: Re-rank when material source, market, cost, or policy evidence changes.

items.title: Audit repository, runtime, deployment, credential, wallet, and persistent-state reality
items.acceptance: Observed state and absent capabilities are documented without reading or exposing secret values.
items.reversal_condition: Repeat after material repository, runtime, deployment, or credential-boundary changes.

items.title: Independently review minimal kernel design and prior branch artifacts
items.acceptance: Review identifies required schemas, invariants, commands, tests, recovery behavior, and unsafe or premature scope.
items.reversal_condition: Re-review after any material architecture or permission expansion.

items.title: Verify kernel, persist audit evidence, and complete bootstrap transition
items.acceptance: Tests and validation pass, audit gaps are persisted, and the BOOTSTRAP to DISCOVERY transition has evidence.
items.reversal_condition: Return to BOOTSTRAP if state cannot be validated or resumed from a fresh process.

items.title: Execute the cheapest high-information opportunity falsification experiment
items.acceptance: A bounded reproducible experiment records prediction, method, evidence, observed result, uncertainty, decision, and next action without capital or external writes.
items.reversal_condition: Replace the selected experiment if current evidence changes the opportunity ranking before execution.

items.title: Falsify the SEC filing-diff API before prototype work
items.acceptance: Current source, substitute, demand and unit-economics evidence supports a build-or-reject decision without implementing a parser.
items.reversal_condition: Reopen only on repeated independent buyer evidence or a genuinely new provenance capability.

items.title: Refresh the register for materially stronger opportunities
items.acceptance: Current primary evidence either adds a stronger falsifiable candidate or records why none qualifies.
items.reversal_condition: Repeat when material platform, source, market or capability evidence changes.

items.title: Falsify Shopify catalog-quality monitoring before build
items.acceptance: A current competitor/review/permission/economics matrix finds a repeated unmet paid wedge or rejects the candidate.
items.reversal_condition: Reopen only on repeated buyer complaints, a new uncovered data surface or incumbent withdrawal.

items.title: Falsify Atlassian access-evidence monitoring before build
items.acceptance: Direct substitutes, complaints, native competition, scopes and economics support a build-or-reject decision.
items.reversal_condition: Reopen only on repeated unmet complaints, an enabling RBAC/API change or qualified buyer pre-commitments.

items.title: Run a bounded isolated Cantina public-scope replay
items.acceptance: One completed public scope is reproduced in isolation without account/submission; analyzer candidates are compared with public outcomes and precision, safety, time and next gate are recorded.
items.reversal_condition: Stop if source permission changes, safe isolation cannot be maintained, or the first replay produces no useful signal for a ten-scope test.
items.deferred_reason: Candidate generation is durably frozen; final comparison is deferred behind the owner-directed crypto-market focus and may resume without repeating completed work.

items.title: Establish an activity-conditioned crypto-market replay baseline
items.acceptance: Public market data and deterministic replays compare at least three crypto strategy families across activity, liquidity, volatility and time-of-week regimes, with fees, spread, slippage, latency, funding, fill probability and failure costs included; the result selects or rejects a zero-capital shadow experiment.
items.reversal_condition: Re-rank if accessible data, venue rules, costs, market structure, Governor authority or measured net edge changes materially.

items.title: Run a preregistered active-weekday breakout forward shadow
items.acceptance: Timestamp decisions before outcomes for BTC-USD and ETH-USD without orders or credentials; reconcile at least 100 eligible observations or 14 calendar days, apply 20 bps per-side costs, and reject unless both products have positive net expectancy with bounded drawdown.
items.reversal_condition: Stop early for data integrity failure, lookahead, inability to resume from durable state, or a materially changed venue/data contract.

items.title: Audit and qualify EPI/Epinnox predecessor knowledge
items.acceptance: Exact non-secret predecessor sources are hash-pinned, useful concepts and unsafe assumptions are distinguished, focused tests are run, and no predecessor code gains runtime authority.
items.reversal_condition: Re-audit a source when its manifest hash or Git provenance changes materially.

items.title: Qualify a minimal deterministic market-data quality contract
items.acceptance: An independently implemented, venue-neutral contract classifies unavailable, stale, degraded, and valid market observations from explicit timestamp/provenance inputs; it fails closed, has tests, and does not modify EXP-MKT-002.
items.reversal_condition: Defer if no future experiment or execution gate consumes source freshness or timestamp-chain evidence.

items.title: Validate epinnox-llm architecture claims and epi-calc economics
items.acceptance: README claims are compared with actual implementation/provenance, unsafe execution paths are rejected, and projection assumptions are not treated as realized economics.
items.reversal_condition: Re-audit only when a clean authoritative source or a current capability bottleneck makes a specific component decision-relevant.

items.title: Build the canonical zero-exposure pre-live operating slice
items.acceptance: First-class experiment and capability registries, typed execution, deterministic Governor authorization, immutable idempotent receipts, zero-effect reconciliation, monitor integration, corruption/restart tests, documentation, and clean validation exist without modifying EXP-MKT-002.
items.reversal_condition: Suspend the path if any pre-live request can move capital, any live request is authorized, receipt conflicts overwrite truth, or shadow outcomes enter realized accounting.

items.title: Build and qualify the canonical provider-neutral market-data plane
items.acceptance: Immutable raw/normalized public observations preserve timestamp provenance and lineage, quality fails closed, storage is replayable/idempotent/recoverable, monitor integration exists, and EXP-MKT-002 remains unchanged.
items.reversal_condition: Suspend if raw lineage, timestamp order, content integrity, provider identity, or deterministic index recovery cannot be established.

items.title: Qualify the complete canonical zero-exposure shadow economic lifecycle
items.acceptance: One prospectively captured VALID observation drives a non-HOLD decision through qualification, Governor authorization, the provider-neutral shadow adapter, deterministic modeled fills, economic-event accounting, declared-shadow reconciliation, immutable receipt, replay, restart/fault tests, and monitor visibility while actual exposure remains exactly zero.
items.reversal_condition: Reject or suspend if any capital effect, external order, credential/signer access, non-determinism, duplicate effect, accounting divergence, receipt corruption, or restart-loss occurs.

items.title: Calibrate or reject shadow execution assumptions from public venue microstructure
items.acceptance: A preregistered zero-capital experiment captures only the public quote, trade, order-book, fee/rule, timestamp, precision, minimum-notional, and depth evidence needed to calibrate or reject explicit deterministic execution assumptions; observed facts, configured assumptions, and modeled outputs remain distinct.
items.reversal_condition: Stop or redesign if public data lacks stable provenance, cannot support timestamp-order and gap checks, or would require credentials, orders, signer access, capital, or contamination of EXP-MKT-002.

items.title: Qualify continuous public microstructure evidence and distributional execution bounds
items.acceptance: A bounded preregistered capture window produces timestamp-ordered, duplicate-safe, crash-recoverable quote/trade/book evidence with provider update-sequence gap detection, staleness classification, deterministic replay, and distributions for spread/depth/slippage proxies; unavailable fee/order/fill truth remains explicitly unqualified.
items.reversal_condition: Stop if public update data cannot be captured with stable provenance and gap semantics, storage cost is disproportionate, or credentials, orders, signer, wallet, or capital would be required.

items.title: Measure activity-conditioned microstructure distributions across independent windows
items.acceptance: Several preregistered time-separated public windows cover different activity/spread/depth regimes and yield reproducible distributions with the qualified journal; they either support or reject configured public-observable bounds without inferring fees, order latency, fill truth, or edge.
items.reversal_condition: Stop if marginal windows do not improve tail estimates, storage/infrastructure cost exceeds information value, provider terms or schemas change, or any authenticated/financial surface would be required.

items.title: Falsify same-exchange spot/perpetual economic mechanisms from checksum-verified history
items.acceptance: The frozen Binance BTC/ETH spot and USD-M perpetual design downloads only official checksum-verified history, enforces aligned data quality and no-lookahead, includes funding and conservative trading costs, reports every frozen walk-forward stream, and nominates at most one family for separate prospective validation.
items.reversal_condition: Reject or redesign under a new experiment ID if integrity, same-exchange alignment, futures economics, family agreement, stability, corrected significance, or conservative net expectancy fails.
